Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to extract the correct place of death from the Wikipedia page it was instructed to visit. In Step 3, the WebSurfer successfully loaded the Wikipedia page (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vivien_Leigh) and the visible text clearly stated "Died 8 July 1967 (aged 53) Belgravia, London, England". However, in Step 4, the Planner's analysis incorrectly claimed that "No confirmed sourced line was captured yet" and that the data was incomplete. The WebSurfer then proceeded to search again for the same Wikipedia page instead of extracting the data that was already visible in the previous turn. This failure to utilize the information present in the browser viewport in Step 3 led to redundant actions and a delay in confirming the answer, which was explicitly stated as "London" in the final answer despite the agent's own earlier retrieval of "Belgravia, London, England".
